author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (portal)

prerequisites: Seeded work lab openlaw-docs-41255c61-work built from 3fa407e3 with its seeded Portal home deflection links (four Knowledge links, one external intranet.helix.example link that does not resolve).

fixtures-r1.mjs created DOC-029 portal guidance (published Everyone, supporting PDF uploaded before the primary PDF, written guidance), restricted (published Legal Only with a PDF), draft (unpublished Everyone with a PDF) and archived (archived Everyone with a PDF) Knowledge Items as Nadia Haddad through the API.
Jonas Weber signs in with a fresh Portal magic link; Nadia adds a Version and unpublishes/republishes in a separate context; a signed-out context checks anonymous access.
scenarios.expected: Only eligible published Knowledge appears and allowed files open through their intended links. Unpublished or out-of-audience items and their files remain unavailable; a broken external link does not block the Request form.
scenarios.actual: Before you submit on the home listed four Knowledge links, each a published Everyone item, and the external link with intranet.helix.example beneath it and target _blank; the Contract review form had no panel. "How to ask legal for help" opened in the same tab with From Legal above the title and Guidance, and Your requests returned to /portal. The DOC-029 guidance item listed the primary Document first although the supporting one was created earlier; each Download matched the staff current Version bytes; there was no version picker or reader; Guidance showed the written text. After Nadia added a Version, the page listed the new filename and Download and the earlier saved address served the new bytes. Draft, restricted, archived and unknown items (and the seeded draft Everyone item) returned the page to /portal and answered 404 for the item and for their files. After Nadia unpublished the guidance, its page returned to /portal and the saved download address answered 404; after republishing it answered 200. The external link opened a new tab that failed to load; the original tab stayed on /portal and the Legal question form then confirmed R-86. Portal navigation offered Requests, Contracts, Matters, Auto-Docs; /knowledge returned to /portal and the staff list API answered 403; the Portal item page had no editing controls. A signed-out browser went to /portal/login and the item and file APIs answered 401. Help search for the guidance title found no link to it.

limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author and the technical reviewer; not a human user study and not the feature owner's approval.

The work lab is shared with other DOC-029 agents. Only records named DOC-029 portal were created; no organisation settings changed. Debug runs of the same script before the recorded run left further DOC-029 portal Requests; they are not credited.
Knowledge fixtures, the new Version, and unpublish/republish were applied through the API as the Legal Team Member; the Knowledge authoring guides own those controls.

The seed has no form-specific deflection links and no links to unavailable items, and this shared lab's intake settings were not changed. The form panel difference and hidden links were therefore observed only as home versus an empty form panel; unavailable items were checked by direct address.
The unreachable external website is a real DNS failure in headless Chromium; the original tab and form were not affected.

compatibilityReview.summary: I inspected the app diff from 3fa407e3 to 57e77e38 and found no change to Portal Knowledge, Before you submit, downloads or Portal navigation. I replayed the round 1 V-C11 walkthrough on the work2 lab and all 12 steps passed.
